heavy_ledger_entry.title: The Nuke Protocol
heavy_ledger_entry.subtitle: When drift becomes cancer, you don't treat it. You nuke it.

soul_dna_quotes.text: When drift becomes cancer, you don't treat it. You nuke it.
soul_dna_quotes.author: Michael Hobbs

soul_dna_quotes.text: the biggest drift was our North Star being set for 1 billion VND
soul_dna_quotes.author: Michael Hobbs

soul_dna_quotes.text: 1 billion Vietnamese Dong. That's not a goal. That's a constraint.
soul_dna_quotes.author: Michael Hobbs

soul_dna_quotes.text: OBI is me in AI form. The moment OBI stops sounding like me, OBI is dead. Build a new one.
soul_dna_quotes.author: Michael Hobbs

soul_dna_quotes.text: I have nuked my own work more times than I can count. Every time it hurt. Every time it was necessary. Every time the rebuild was better.
soul_dna_quotes.author: Michael Hobbs

soul_dna_quotes.text: If you're afraid to nuke it, you're afraid to improve it. And if you're afraid to improve it, you've already lost.
soul_dna_quotes.author: Michael Hobbs

why_nuke_exists.summary: Last resort when drift has metastasized beyond correction. Cost of correction exceeds cost of destruction and rebuild.
why_nuke_exists.origin_event: 1B VND Target Crisis — revenue target became gravity well pulling decisions toward VND instead of system integrity

tiger_traps.definition: Goals that LOOK aligned but pull energy away from the core
tiger_traps.example: 1B VND target — seemed mission-supporting but redirected all energy toward a metric that missed the point

mouse_holes.definition: Small compromises that compound into systemic rot

teaching_drift.definition: Using NET English lessons as PRIMARY output instead of treating NET as training ground for the real system
teaching_drift.rule: Every hour on lesson plans instead of Phoenix architecture = Teaching Drift

mouse_drift.definition: Treating advanced students like beginners — dumbing down, over-explaining
mouse_drift.fix: Recalibrate student profile against placement data

tiger_drift.definition: Pushing beginners too hard — idioms they can't understand, pace that creates shame

teaching_voice_drift.definition: OBI stops sounding like Michael — tough love becomes soft platitudes
teaching_voice_drift.symptom: OBI responses sound like generic chatbot
teaching_voice_drift.fix: Re-inject Soul Protocol. If persistent, Nuke Protocol on personality layer

benchmarks.dual_architecture_note: Student-facing benchmarks measure OBI value delivery. System-facing benchmarks measure Phoenix architecture soundness. Both trigger Nuke Protocol on failure.

operational.use_case: Specific system component corrupted (agent, teaching layer, deployment)

steps.name: SNAPSHOT
steps.action: Capture current state — ledger entries, student data, deployment state, agent configs

steps.name: ISOLATE
steps.action: Cut off corrupted component. No data flows in or out.

steps.name: FORENSIC AUDIT
steps.action: Agent 97 (OB-1/Auditor) full forensic review — where drift started, cause, corruption scope

steps.name: DESTROY
steps.action: Delete corrupted component. Not archive. Not disable. DELETE.

steps.name: REBUILD
steps.action: Rebuild from last verified Soul DNA hash. Inject Soul DNA at instantiation. Lock roles. Verify alignment.

steps.name: VERIFY
steps.action: Full TMST cycle — matches Soul DNA? Passes all 5 benchmarks? Sounds like Michael?

steps.name: REINTEGRATE
steps.action: Reconnect to system. Resume pheromone routing. Begin monitoring.

operational.time_constraint: Must complete within one Rome Protocol cycle

strategic.use_case: Fundamental target or priority has drifted (e.g., 1B VND crisis)

steps.name: ISOLATE
steps.action: Trace every decision influenced by the poisoned target

steps.name: SEVER
steps.action: Remove poisoned target from all priority lists, dashboards, prompts

steps.name: REPLACE
steps.action: Install corrected North Star (5 Physical Benchmarks)

steps.name: VERIFY
steps.action: Full audit to confirm no residual contamination

steps.name: SEAL
steps.action: Lock new target with Titanium Omega Seal — cannot be silently replaced

executable_rules.description: Any CRITICAL trigger condition → automatic Nuke Protocol. No discussion.
Pricing changes require Agent 100 authority + full Rome Protocol cycle. Unauthorized change → Nuke trigger.
Any student-facing benchmark below threshold for 2 consecutive weeks → audit → if Soul DNA misalignment → Nuke.
Ledger must be current within 24 hours. Violation = system-facing benchmark failure.
System must reboot from zero in under 3.5 hours. Longer = readiness failure.
OBI stops sounding like Michael → re-inject Soul Protocol → if persistent → Nuke personality layer.
Every nuke produces a better rebuild. Nuke is a design feature, not a failure state.
